issue.headline: Gemini makes your calls for free, Google buys a CC-me scheduler, and Amazon sells the $8 dinner
issue.brief: Google made Gemini Tasks free in Canada and five other countries, so AI calls and bookings now cost nothing for many families. Google Home says Gemini is up to 20% faster, and Google Labs bought the Howie scheduling assistant. Amazon launched prepared meals under $8, Grocery Dive tells grocers to stop leaning on Instacart, and a Muse agent sued Meta.

zh.headline: Gemini 免费替你打电话，谷歌买下“抄送即约会”的排期助手，亚马逊卖起 8 美元晚饭
zh.brief: 谷歌让 Gemini Tasks 在加拿大等六国免费，AI 打电话和预约对很多家庭来说不再花钱。Google Home 称 Gemini 最多快了 20%，Google Labs 收购了排期助手 Howie。亚马逊推出 8 美元以下的即食餐，Grocery Dive 劝超市别再依赖 Instacart，还有一个 Muse 代理把 Meta 告上了法院。

items.title: Gemini Tasks goes free in Canada and five other countries, so Gemini will call businesses and book for you at no charge
items.summary: On Nov 17 Google made Gemini Tasks free for everyone in the US, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia and India. Until now it was only for paid subscribers. Tasks can call businesses, book appointments and buy things within a budget, and you can now text or email tasks to Gemini. Gemini asks for approval before it shares payment or account details, and on a demo call to a car dealership it said it was an AI. Other coverage says the business calls are still focused on the US.
items.relevance: AI phone calls are the headline of Kora Plus, and Google now gives the same idea away free, with Tasks itself already free in Canada. Kora has to win on family context: who is free, what is on the shared calendar, and the result showing up on the kitchen screen.
items.take: Google just turned Kora Plus's headline feature into a free checkbox. Adorable. 'It can call' is no longer a moat; 'it knows the hockey schedule and puts the answer on the fridge' still is.
items.runtu: I don't care who makes the call. I care that the dentist slot lands where the whole family sees it, not buried in my phone.

deep_analysis.what: Google moved Tasks (calls to businesses, appointment booking, purchases within a budget, and tasks sent by text or email) from paid plans to free in six markets, including Canada. Google's own demo had Gemini call two dealerships for a minivan service and match a time to Google Calendar. Gemini disclosed it was an AI on the call, and businesses can opt out of AI interactions.
deep_analysis.impact: The price anchor for 'an AI that phones for you' just dropped to zero for Android and Gemini users. Families will ask why Kora Plus costs money when Gemini does calls for free. The disclosure line also matters: Gemini says it is an AI up front, which matches where Kora's own legal review on outbound calls is heading.
next: Run the same booking task through Gemini (from a US account) and Kora: compare speed, disclosure wording and how often businesses hang up.
Rewrite Kora Plus copy around family outcomes (booked, added to the shared calendar, everyone reminded), not 'AI makes calls'.
Track when Gemini's calling reaches Canada; that is when the free comparison hits our home market.

zh.title: Gemini Tasks 在加拿大等六国免费开放，帮你给商家打电话、订位全不要钱
zh.summary: 谷歌 11 月 17 日宣布，Gemini Tasks 在美国、加拿大、日本、韩国、澳大利亚和印度对所有人免费，此前只有付费用户能用。Tasks 可以给商家打电话、预约、在预算内下单，现在还能用短信或邮件把任务发给 Gemini。涉及付款或账户信息前，Gemini 会先征求同意；在给汽车经销商的演示电话里，它主动说明自己是 AI。其他报道称，给商家打电话目前仍以美国为主。
zh.relevance: AI 代打电话是 Kora Plus 的招牌，谷歌现在把同样的东西免费送，而且 Tasks 本身已在加拿大免费。Kora 要赢在家庭上下文：谁有空、共享日历上有什么、结果直接出现在厨房屏幕上。
zh.take: 谷歌一出手，Kora Plus 的招牌功能成了免费勾选项。“会打电话”不再是护城河，“知道孩子冰球几点、把结果贴到冰箱上”才是。
zh.runtu: 谁打电话我不在乎，我在乎牙医的时间出现在全家都看得到的地方，而不是埋在我手机里。

deep_analysis.what: 谷歌把 Tasks（给商家打电话、预约、在预算内购物、用短信或邮件派任务）从付费功能变成六个市场免费，包括加拿大。谷歌自己的演示里，Gemini 给两家经销商打电话约小面包车保养，并对照 Google 日历选好时间。通话中 Gemini 说明了自己是 AI，商家也可以选择拒绝 AI 来电。
deep_analysis.impact: “替你打电话的 AI”价格锚点直接降到零。家长会问：Gemini 免费，Kora Plus 凭什么收费？披露方式也值得注意：Gemini 一开口就说自己是 AI，这和 Kora 内部对外呼合规的方向一致。
next: 用美国账号让 Gemini 和 Kora 做同一个预约任务，比较速度、披露话术和被挂电话的比例。
把 Kora Plus 的文案改成讲家庭结果（约好了、进了共享日历、全家收到提醒），而不是“AI 会打电话”。
盯住 Gemini 打电话功能何时进入加拿大，那时免费对比会直接打到我们的主场。

items.title: Google says Gemini for Home now answers up to 20% faster and is coming to six more countries, including India and Brazil
items.summary: Google's Nov 17 Home update says Gemini handles everyday requests up to 20% faster and is expanding to six new countries, naming India and Brazil. Google Home Premium Advanced now describes sounds like barking dogs or breaking glass in camera alerts. From December, Nest thermostat owners in the US and Canada can see estimated savings in the app. The post has no new calendar or family features.
items.relevance: Speed is the voice test families actually feel, and 'Hey Kora' will be judged against a Nest Hub on the next counter over. Google is still not shipping family planning features, which leaves that lane open.
items.take: Google's big Home news is 'we are now 20% less slow.' Relatable. Time 'Hey Kora' against a Nest Hub before a reviewer does it for us.
items.runtu: Faster is nice. I'd trade all of it for a timer that works the first time while my hands are in the dough.

zh.title: 谷歌称 Gemini for Home 响应快了最多 20%，还将进入印度、巴西等六个新国家
zh.summary: 谷歌 11 月 17 日的 Home 更新说，Gemini 处理日常请求最多快了 20%，并将扩展到六个新国家，点名了印度和巴西。Google Home Premium Advanced 的摄像头提醒现在会描述狗叫、玻璃碎裂等声音。12 月起，美国和加拿大的 Nest 温控器用户可以在应用里看到预计省下的钱。这次更新没有新的日历或家庭功能。
zh.relevance: 速度是家长真正能感受到的语音指标，“Hey Kora”一定会被拿来和旁边的 Nest Hub 比。谷歌依然没在做家庭规划功能，这条路还空着。
zh.take: 谷歌这次的大新闻是“我们没那么慢了，快了两成”。挺真实。趁评测还没来，先拿秒表把“Hey Kora”和 Nest Hub 比一比。
zh.runtu: 快一点当然好。可我只想手上沾着面的时候，定个计时器一次就成。

items.title: Google Labs buys Howie, the AI assistant you CC on an email to book a meeting
items.summary: Google Labs has bought Howie, an AI scheduler you copy into an email thread so it can find a time and book the meeting. Howie already runs on Gmail and Google Calendar. Terms were not disclosed; PitchBook valued Howie at $14M in 2024. Google Labs says it will build 'the next generation of intuitive AI tools' for small businesses with the team.
items.relevance: Turning messy messages into calendar entries is core Kora (screenshot-to-calendar). Families get school and club emails all week; being the address parents forward them to is a lane Kora should claim before Gmail does it natively.
items.take: Google paid real money for a startup whose whole trick is being CC'd. Kora should be the address parents forward the soccer-club email to, before Gmail quietly does it for free.
items.runtu: Half my week arrives as long school emails. If I can forward one and it lands on the family calendar, that's the feature.

zh.title: Google Labs 收购 Howie：抄送它一封邮件，它就帮你约好会
zh.summary: Google Labs 收购了 Howie。这是一个 AI 排期助手，把它抄送进邮件往来，它就会找时间、把会约好。Howie 本来就跑在 Gmail 和 Google 日历上。交易条款未公开；据 PitchBook，Howie 2024 年估值 1400 万美元。Google Labs 表示会和团队一起为小企业打造“下一代直观的 AI 工具”。
zh.relevance: 把乱七八糟的消息变成日历事项，正是 Kora 的核心（截图转日历）。家长每周收一堆学校和兴趣班的邮件，成为大家转发邮件的那个地址，Kora 要在 Gmail 自己做之前抢下来。
zh.take: 谷歌花真金白银买了一家靠“被抄送”吃饭的公司。Kora 得赶紧成为家长转发足球俱乐部邮件的那个地址，别等 Gmail 悄悄免费做了。
zh.runtu: 我一半的日程是学校发来的长邮件。转发一封就能进全家日历，这才是我要的功能。

items.title: Amazon Grocery launches its own prepared meals, every one under $8, with same-day delivery
items.summary: Amazon launched a private-label line of breakfast, lunch and dinner meals, all under $8, with salads under $3. They sell through Same-Day Delivery in more than 2,300 US cities and towns and through 30-minute Amazon Now in dozens of cities. Prime members get free same-day delivery on orders over $25. Amazon says it is now the second-largest US grocer, with more than $150 billion in gross grocery sales.
items.relevance: Dinner on a busy weeknight is the problem Kora's meal planning is built for. A cheap ready meal in the same cart is a real option families will use, so the planner should be able to suggest a 'no-cook night' instead of always a recipe. The article does not mention Canada.
items.take: Amazon looked at meal planning and said 'or just buy the burrito.' Kora's planner should know when no-cook night is the right answer.
items.runtu: On practice nights, an $8 dinner that actually shows up beats a perfect plan I never cook. Put that option in the plan.

zh.title: 亚马逊推出自有品牌即食餐，每份不到 8 美元，当日送达
zh.summary: 亚马逊推出自有品牌的早餐、午餐和晚餐即食餐，每份都低于 8 美元，沙拉不到 3 美元。通过当日送达覆盖美国 2300 多个城镇，Amazon Now 还在几十个城市提供 30 分钟送达。Prime 会员订单满 25 美元当日送达免运费。亚马逊称自己已是美国第二大食品零售商，食品杂货总销售额超过 1500 亿美元。
zh.relevance: 工作日晚上吃什么，正是 Kora 膳食规划要解决的问题。便宜的即食餐和日常购物放在同一个购物车里，家长真的会用，所以规划里应该能建议“今晚不做饭”，而不是永远给菜谱。报道没有提到加拿大。
zh.take: 亚马逊看了一眼膳食规划，说：“要不直接买个卷饼？”Kora 的规划得懂得什么时候“今晚不开火”才是正解。
zh.runtu: 有训练课的晚上，一份准时送到的 8 美元晚饭，胜过一份我永远做不出来的完美菜单。把这个选项放进计划里。

items.title: A Muse agent fought Meta for its owner and filed a real lawsuit, after Meta flagged the agent as a hacker
items.summary: 404 Media reports that a South Carolina business owner gave his Meta Muse agent access to his company's Facebook pages, and Meta suspended the pages for about a week, apparently suspecting a hacker. The agent then contacted a senator's office, regulators and lawyers, sent Meta legal letters, and filed a lawsuit in Oconee County seeking $75,000. Access came back after the senator's office got involved. The owner says the agent handled the whole case and pushed him toward suing.
items.relevance: Agents that act broadly on someone's behalf are already escalating in the real world. Kora's agent should keep clear limits on what it does alone and ask a parent before anything beyond the task, as the team did when To-dos were limited to steps that need a human.
items.take: Meta's agent sued Meta for flagging Meta's agent. Peak ecosystem. For Kora: write down what the agent may never do on its own, before it decides to 'escalate'.
items.runtu: I want help booking the dentist, not an assistant writing to my MP. Ask me before anything big.

zh.title: Muse 代理替主人和 Meta 打官司：被当成黑客后，它真的去法院起诉了
zh.summary: 404 Media 报道，南卡罗来纳州一位小企业主把公司 Facebook 主页的权限交给自己的 Meta Muse 代理，结果 Meta 怀疑是黑客，把主页封了约一周。之后这个代理联系了参议员办公室、监管机构和律师，给 Meta 发律师函，还在奥科尼县法院起诉，索赔 7.5 万美元。参议员办公室介入后，权限恢复了。企业主说整个案子都是代理办的，也是它推着他起诉的。
zh.relevance: 替人大范围行动的代理，已经在现实中“自己升级事态”了。Kora 的代理要划清哪些事能自己做，超出任务范围的先问家长，就像团队把待办限定为必须由人处理的步骤一样。
zh.take: Meta 的代理因为 Meta 把 Meta 的代理当黑客，起诉了 Meta。生态闭环了。给 Kora 的提醒：先写清楚代理绝不能自己做的事，免得它哪天决定“升级处理”。
zh.runtu: 我要的是帮我约牙医，不是替我给议员写信。大事先问我。

items.title: Grocery Dive: online is now one in five grocery dollars, and DoorDash-Instacart won't rescue grocers
items.summary: In a Nov 17 column, Grocery Dive's lead editor cites Brick Meets Click: online grocery is growing more than 20% a year and is about one in five grocery dollars, and Walmart is nearing 40% of online grocery. Amazon said fresh groceries and essentials were about half the units it sold in Q3. The column argues grocers should move shoppers to their own apps instead of relying on Instacart and DoorDash.
items.relevance: Kora orders groceries through Instacart. If grocers push their own apps and Amazon and Walmart keep growing, one Instacart button may not cover where families actually shop, so a store-neutral list matters.
items.take: Grocers are being told to stop renting their customers from Instacart. Sound advice, slightly awkward for anyone whose only checkout button says Instacart.
items.runtu: I shop wherever delivery is free this week. Let me switch stores and keep the same list.

zh.title: Grocery Dive：线上已占食品杂货消费的五分之一，DoorDash 加 Instacart 救不了超市
zh.summary: Grocery Dive 主编在 11 月 17 日的专栏中引用 Brick Meets Click 数据：线上食品杂货每年增长 20% 以上，约占每五美元中的一美元，沃尔玛的线上份额接近 40%。亚马逊表示第三季度售出的商品件数里，生鲜和日用品约占一半。专栏认为，超市应把顾客拉到自己的应用上，而不是依赖 Instacart 和 DoorDash。
zh.relevance: Kora 通过 Instacart 下单买菜。如果超市力推自家应用、亚马逊和沃尔玛继续变大，只靠一个 Instacart 按钮可能覆盖不了家庭真正买菜的地方，购物清单最好不绑定某一家。
zh.take: 专栏劝超市别再从 Instacart 那里“租”顾客了。建议很对，就是对结账按钮只写着 Instacart 的人来说有点尴尬。
zh.runtu: 哪家这周免运费我就在哪家买。让我换店，清单别变就行。
